chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen. Today I am going to tell you how to make Jeera Aloo. If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel. First of all, I have boiled and chopped the potatoes. I have let them cool down and then peeled them. Otherwise, they would have broken. Now we will do the second process. We have put the pan on the stove. Now we will add oil to it. Oil should be a little more. Oil will be heated. We will add cumin seeds and coriander seeds to it. Oil should be heated well. Now we will add cumin seeds and coriander seeds. Cumin seeds will be a little more. We will slow it down and let it fry well. Cumin seeds should be flavored well. Cumin seeds will be a little more. We are making Jeera Aloo. Now we will add a pinch of asafoetida to it. It will give a good flavor. Now we will add our potatoes. We will mix it well. We will mix it well. It should be mixed well. We have to mix it well. So that the coating of cumin seeds should be coated well. And our Jeera Aloo is made in a very first class way. Now at this stage, we have to add salt to it. We are adding half a teaspoon of white salt and half a teaspoon of black salt to it. We have to mix it well so that the coating is well coated. And our Jeera Aloo is made very crispy. Now we will add ginger to it. We will add ginger to it. We will add spices and other ingredients. We will add ginger. We will add half a teaspoon of turmeric powder. We will not add a lot of spices. And we will add crushed red chilies. We will add half a teaspoon of cumin powder. We will add two chopped red chilies according to our taste. We will add half a teaspoon of dry mango powder. If you want to add chaat masala, you can add that too. Our Jeera Aloo will be very spicy. And we will add half a teaspoon of garam masala. Now we will mix it well. And we will add a teaspoon of mint powder to it. It gives a very nice flavor. We will add a teaspoon of roasted fenugreek leaves to it. And we will add fresh chopped coriander to it. And we will mix it well. We will put a lid on it and keep the flame on low. We will keep it for a minute or two so that the spices get mixed well with the potatoes. We will put the lid on it and our Jeera Aloo is ready. If you like the recipe, please like it and subscribe to the channel.
